paragraphs.text: This Levite was called Amram, who married Jochebed in Ex 6:20.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: man of the house of Levi

paragraphs.text: Committing him to the providence of God, whom she could not keep from the rage of the tyrant.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Man's counsel cannot hinder that which God has determined shall come to pass.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: That is, was forty years old; Ac 7:23.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Being assured that God had appointed him to deliver the Israelites; Ac 7:25.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Though by his fear he showed his weakness, yet faith covered it; He 11:27.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: In which he demonstrated a thankful mind, which would reward the good done to his.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: God humbles his by afflictions, that they should cry to him, and receive the fruit of his promise.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: He judges their causes or acknowledged them as his own.
